title: OversightCertificate
description: E4 (plan: 'oversight-certificate' -- Postflight assurance; 'Cannot certify unadmitted, mismatched or incomplete run'). Issued ONLY by wire.certification.certify(), and only when every gate holds: the permit E1-verifies and was issued at an enforcement grade (mediated/platform); every ToolReceipt E1-verifies and binds this action_digest; the Reconciliation E1-verifies, binds this action_digest, and is certified=true with zero residuals; every blocking obligation has a verified ObligationDischargeReceipt bound to this action_digest; all mandatory sources are fresh. Binds the exact run by content-addressed digest reference (permit_digest, reconciliation_digest, tool_receipt_digests) rather than embedding those objects, so a certificate cannot be replayed against a different/tampered permit, reconciliation or receipt set without the digest fields failing to match on re-verification (see wire/audit_chain.py:audit_chain_verify). A successful ToolReceipt alone can never produce this object: certify() requires the Reconciliation's own certified=true (effects matched) in addition to receipt verification.

permit_digest.description: subject_digest of the ExecutionPermit this certificate attests

reconciliation_digest.description: subject_digest of the certified=true, zero-residual Reconciliation this certificate attests

tool_receipt_digests.description: subject_digest of every ToolReceipt this certificate attests, in the order reconciled; a removed/reordered/inserted receipt changes this list

discharged_obligation_digests.description: subject_digest of the verified ObligationDischargeReceipt for each blocking obligation this run required; empty array means no blocking obligations applied, never omitted

certifier.description: the assurance-signer identity; must be distinct from the permit issuer, every tool-receipt recorder/executor and the approver in this run (role separation, plan: 'Fixed trust boundary')

prev_digest.description: OPTIONAL: the subject_digest of the immediately preceding object in the run's audit chain (typically the Reconciliation); absent only on a chain's first (genesis) element. See wire/audit_chain.py:audit_chain_verify.
